data.narrative:
Genesis AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $105M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised of $105M as a proxy for current value, a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $262M. This produces a range of $223M (low), $262M (median), and $302M (high), reflecting reasonable variance around the point estimate.

The peer-median approach, while standard practice, could not be applied due to insufficient comparable data. Though ten same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, none of the narrow screening criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) returned the minimum three datapoints required for statistical reliability. A broader sectoral median would risk material distortion.

The $262M median valuation is therefore supported by stage-progression mechanics alone. Key uncertainties include: the true post-Seed pricing environment for frontier robotics, customer traction metrics not reflected in capital raised, and competitive positioning relative to both private and public peers. Additional transaction or financing data from the peer set would substantially strengthen confidence in this range.
